goal: 把本项目做成业界领先的记忆体系，并时刻了解自己的目标和交付成果。

north_star.definition: Share of labeled replay contexts containing every required memory, no forbidden memory, and no exposed contradiction.
north_star.target: >= 0.80 on replay-derived evaluation, with scenario pass rate = 1.00
north_star.evidence_command: make north-star (live) and make replay-benchmark (auditable artifact)

current_milestone.title: Trustworthy memory kernel
current_milestone.outcome: A durable, replay-evaluated memory kernel that governs branch-aware context and resolves conflicts with auditable evidence.

deliverables.title: Typed memory atoms, evidence, scope, TTL, and citations
deliverables.next_action: Preserve invariants while storage adapters evolve.

deliverables.title: Role-aware selective disclosure and runtime governance
deliverables.next_action: Exercise policy what-if and signed audit export in the target rollout pipeline.

deliverables.title: Branch inheritance, child override, and conflict diagnostics
deliverables.next_action: Use these semantics as the contract for persistent stores.

deliverables.title: Replay-derived comparative evaluation with confidence intervals
deliverables.next_action: Collect privacy-approved sanitized execution replays under the manifest protocol and rerun the paired confidence intervals beyond the synthetic fixture.

deliverables.title: Durable storage with graph and vector adapter parity
deliverables.next_action: Run the executable runtime qualification profile with the selected production embedding provider.

deliverables.title: Evidence-aware automatic conflict resolution
deliverables.next_action: Calibrate authority weights against replay-derived outcomes.

deliverables.title: Consolidation, forgetting, deletion, and poisoning recovery
deliverables.next_action: Qualify propagation policies against execution-derived poisoning incidents and external deletion requirements.

deliverables.title: Production-scale reliability qualification
deliverables.next_action: Run the executable qualification gate with the selected semantic model and retention evidence in the target production environment.

deliverables.title: Purpose-bound, explainable, versioned governance audit
deliverables.next_action: Connect signed audit export to production key custody and immutable retention.

deliverables.title: Policy linting and permission-expansion what-if gate
deliverables.next_action: Feed execution-derived audit samples into the what-if gate before every production policy rollout.

deliverables.title: Tamper-evident signed governance audit export
deliverables.next_action: Integrate KMS/HSM custody, WORM storage, key revocation, and external timestamping in the target environment.
